name: Venator
fantasy: The ember-rifle skirmisher. Bounces a spiked charge off the wall so its blast throws a foe back into his rifle, slides around while still shooting, and finishes with one long needle of light.
silhouette: the long scarf streaming behind, the bandolier of spiked charges across the chest and the long-shrouded rifle

card.loop: Mid-range rifleman: Daze a foe with the grenade's cone, then shred them while it lasts.
card.dash: Slipstep: tap to skid, hold to slide further; you can shoot the whole time and it goes where you move, not where you aim.
card.passive: Hot Streak: knocking a hunter down gives Slipstep back and heals you. Abilities that land add a little lifesteal.
card.rmb: Burr Charge: hold to see its lane, let go to throw. It flies past people and blasts a cone back at you where it hits a wall or the ground, Dazing everyone in it.
card.e: Longneedle: stand still 0.6s while the line narrows, then fire a long beam through walls and everything in it.

weapons.quill_rifle: Full-auto rifle out to full range. Long strings lose punch; Dazed foes take 90% more (big gold numbers).

passive.name: Hot Streak
passive.desc: Knocking a hunter down gives Slipstep back at once and heals a quarter of your health. Each ability that lands (a Burr Charge blast, Longneedle) also adds a stack of Fever, up to 4, lasting 3.5s: every stack makes your damage heal you for 5%, rifle included. Your rifle does 90% more to a Dazed foe (the numbers turn big and gold), and a string on a Dazed foe doesn't lose its punch.

dash.name: Slipstep
dash.desc: Tap: a quick 4.6m skid the way you're moving (not where you aim). Hold: a 7m low slide. You keep shooting through either, and the body keeps aiming. Let go early and part of the cooldown comes back. A knock gives it back.

variants.tap: Hold RMB: a 10.5m lane with an arrow tip shows (foes in it are marked); let go to throw. The charge flies the whole lane, past the cursor and straight past people.
variants.full: Where it hits a wall, or the ground at the end of the lane, it sticks and a 6m, 100° cone shows back toward you for 0.9s. Then it blasts: 16 damage, a big shove along the cone, Dazed 1.4s. A hunter shoved into more terrain is stunned 0.7s and the cooldown drops 40%.

e.name: Longneedle
e.desc: Stand still and charge for 0.6s: a wide line out to 18m narrows to a thin core. Then the beam fires through cover and everything in its line: 36 damage, 20% more on a Dazed foe, and a Dazed hunter hit is Skewered. The recoil shoves you back a step. Hitting a hunter takes 30% off its cooldown.

rank3.sec: resets when you knock a hunter
rank3.dash: a burst of speed for 2s when a slide ends
rank3.kin: every hunter hit takes 30% off the cooldown

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 6.5s -> 5.2s; resets when you knock a hunter.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 8.5s -> 6.8s; +25% speed for 2s when a slide ends.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 11.5s -> 9.2s, damage +40%; every hunter hit takes 30% off the cooldown.

tells.half: a ring of Fever pips over the cap
tells.full: four bright pips and a heat shimmer
tells.dash_spent: an ember afterimage and a ring where the slide began
